Karibu! This is the first official meetup of {{< var org.name >}}. Whether you use R every day or you're just curious about it, come and meet the people building an R community in Tanzania.

## What to expect

- **Welcome and introductions.** Who we are and why we started this community.
- **Lightning talks.** Three or four short talks (5 minutes each) from members about how they use R. [Want to give one?](../../join.qmd#speak)
- **Open discussion.** What should we do in 2027? Workshops, study groups, hackathons, a conference? You decide.
- **Networking.** Chai, conversation and new connections.

## Who should come

Everyone is welcome: students, researchers, analysts, developers and complete beginners. You don't need to bring a laptop.

## How to register

Registration is free. <!-- TODO: replace with the real registration link, e.g. a Meetup event or a Google Form -->
